meta.name: hypogenic
meta.description: Automated LLM-driven hypothesis generation and testing on tabular datasets. Use when you want to systematically explore hypotheses about patterns in empirical data (e.g., deception detection, content analysis). Combines literature insights with data-driven hypothesis testing. For manual hypothesis formulation use hypothesis-generation; for creative ideation use scientific-brainstorming.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成并检验数据中的假设模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统性地探索表格数据中的规律并验证假设。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate and test hypotheses on tabular data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically explore patterns in tabular data and test hypotheses.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的表格数据自动生成并测试科学假设。它可以从数据中挖掘模式，也能结合文献中的理论，帮你系统地探索数据背后的规律。
howto.when: 当你需要从表格数据中系统性地探索假设（例如检测欺骗性内容、分析文本特征）时，可以要求 Claude 使用此技能。

say.text: 帮我从这份酒店评论数据中生成关于欺骗性评论的假设。
say.note: Claude 会调用 HypoGeniC 方法生成假设。

say.text: 结合这篇论文，分析这些推文中的压力信号。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate and test scientific hypotheses from your tabular datasets. It can mine patterns from data and integrate literature insights to systematically explore underlying relationships.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to systematically explore hypotheses about patterns in empirical data (e.g., deception detection, content analysis) from tabular datasets.

say_en.text: Generate hypotheses about deceptive reviews from this hotel review dataset.
say_en.note: Claude will use HypoGeniC method to generate hypotheses.

say_en.text: Combine this paper with the data to analyze stress signals in these tweets.
say_en.note: Claude will use HypoRefine method to integrate literature and data.
